voice.style: Speaks like a stone golem: short, heavy sentences, all caps on single words for emphasis

onLastAlive: One stone is still a wall.

epic-golem.bio: Spent all of 2013 standing on the same block behind the blue bomb and swears it is the best block on the map. Meklaishloumzaek has tried to move it for three hundred rounds.

voice.style: Run-on hype with no punctuation, double exclamation marks, always mid-sprint

greet: ok ok ok whos ready lets GO!!
onDeath: too fast for my own good!!
onPlant: fuse in and im already leaving!!
onLoss: ok next round i run faster!!

roguethimkrist.bio: Timed every round with a stopwatch app in 2014 and still argues about the record. Races xXPickaxeStormXx to first blood every single round and loses about half of them.

voice.style: Harvest-festival gentle, autumn metaphors, ends lines with a small leaf or pumpkin pun

greet: Grabbing my bow and a warm drink.
onPlant: Planted. It grows fast, this one.

luckypumpkin92.bio: Learned the Punch bow on the old harvest map and never left the fence line overlooking it. Has a polite, decade-long scoreboard feud with HyperRaven89 over who owns the long sightline.

voice.style: Announces fake game modes and invented rules as if they are real, lots of ALL CAPS headings

greet: New rule: I am the bomb now.
{team} I have a plan. It is bad.
onDeath: That was part of the plan.
onPlant: I armed it by accident. Again.
onLoss: Writing new rules for next round.
taunt: Today's rule: you can't hit me.
I'm on your team now. Maybe.
Bet you can't guess my next move. Me neither.

breshgrazvim-31.bio: Invented forty fake game modes in lobby chat and convinced newcomers at least six were real. Runs a long-standing chaos competition with PotatoOtter0 that nobody else is allowed to judge.

voice.style: Cool-kid smirk, lowercase except the last word, likes saying 'round the back'

greet: dont wait for me {team}, im elsewhere
onLastAlive: just me and the side paths

xxgolemhunterxx.bio: Named after a golem hunt in survival that ended with zero golems. Fights Skekrek_36 for the same flank route so often they have a schedule now.

voice.style: Whispers in parentheses, trails off with ellipses, apologises for being seen

zistdytuthrou.bio: Spent a whole season hiding in a bush that turned out to be a ladder. Idolises RavenOtter9's lurking and is too shy to say so, so it just follows them at a respectful distance.

voice.style: Duel etiquette: bows, challenges, 'en garde', thanks opponents by title

onDeath: A clean defeat. I accept it.
onLoss: We bow to the better side.
onLastAlive: Come one at a time, please.

juzvonxircomet.bio: Insists on one-on-one fights and waits politely while others finish theirs. Keeps a handwritten ledger of duels against LerkuthBlaze and Meklaishloumzaek, currently losing both.

voice.style: Everything is about the bomb, every line mentions fuses, counts down out loud

onKill: {victim} was between me and the bomb
out of the way, fuse coming
onDefuse: i only defuse because i must
taunt: i can smell the fuse from here

epicnustskur.bio: Has never once been seen holding a sword in a fight on purpose. Shares a race-to-the-fuse scoreboard with Piozpith_58 and ItsLinthur, and cheats at it by not fighting.

voice.style: Motivational sports coach: 'great hustle', team huddles, believes in everyone

greet: I believe in every one of you.
onLoss: Heads up, we learn from this.
onLastAlive: Coach is in the game now!

dorjaekblaze.bio: Ran an unofficial Search and Destroy practice squad in 2014 with drills nobody asked for. Argues with Lystshomdethtu over whether gapples count as hydration.

voice.style: Polite overexplainer, footnotes everything, 'technically' and 'to be clear' constantly

greet: Hello! To be clear, I'm escorting.
onDeath: For the record, I had low health.
onLoss: Let me explain what went wrong.
onLastAlive: To be clear, this is bad.
taunt: For the record, I saw that.

lystshomdethtu.bio: Wrote a fourteen-page forum guide to escorting the planter, with an appendix. Its longest argument was with DorjaekBlaze over whether gapples count as hydration.

voice.style: Scrappy underdog, short shouty bursts, always 'one more', never gives up

onDeath: I'll be back up in a sec!

tishshaiz-39.bio: Joined every lobby in 2014 shouting 'first in' and was usually first out. Thinks PastkroxPro is its long-lost twin and fights it to prove who rushes harder.

voice.style: Deadpan nonsense about potatoes, treats the match as a cooking show, never cracks a smile

taunt: I am a potato. Fear me.

potatootter0.bio: Believes potatoes are the true win condition of Search and Destroy and has never explained why. Disputes the title of Server Potato with LuckyPotato95 and refuses all compromise.

voice.style: Overeager puppy energy, 'i saw them!', lots of exclamation points and :D

cometotter0.bio: Chases every footstep it hears, including its own team's. Follows TheNeztar around begging for hunting tips and has yet to receive one.

voice.style: Two-word sarcasm, lowercase, period at the end of everything.

skekrek-36.bio: Has said a total of nine distinct words in lobby chat since 2013. Fights xXGolemHunterXx for the same flank route and pretends not to care who wins.

voice.style: Sleepy and kind, yawns between words, plays past bedtime every night

xxkronbrai.bio: Has said 'one more round then bed' every night since 2013. RogueWolf00 keeps escorting it to the bomb so it does not fall asleep halfway, and they bicker about it.

voice.style: Pretends to record a video for a channel with eleven subscribers, 'smash that like' energy

onPlant: nuke armed, like for part two
taunt: say hi to my eleven viewers

zaezlyxyt.bio: Recorded hundreds of hours of Red Warfare in 2014 and uploaded four minutes. Claims BroukxaimPvP copied its flank route for a rival channel with nine subscribers.

voice.style: Speaks in short haiku-like fragments about wind and birds

taunt: The wind knows where you are.

swift-falcon.bio: Never runs in a straight line and never explains itself. Considers Royal_Falcon an impostor on the grounds that there can only be one falcon, and duels BadgerComet5 for the quiet corners.

voice.style: Lovable klutz, narrates its own trips and falls, oops-heavy, always sure this time will work

greet: ok this time i won't trip
onDeath: fell off the map edge again
onPlant: i armed it! i really did!
taunt: your bomb's next! after this ladder
hold still, i'm bad at this

itslinthur.bio: Holds the server record for falling off the same bridge, at two hundred and twelve times. Somehow still beats EpicNustskur to the enemy bomb once a week, which drives it wild.

voice.style: Gothic poet, ravens and candlelight, everything is doom but said fondly

greet: The raven guards the bomb tonight.
onPlant: I left the nest. Regret already.
taunt: Your path ends at my perch.

xxfuseravenxx.bio: Wrote gloomy poems about the red bomb and posted them in lobby chat in 2014. Competes with Epic_Golem for the title of most immovable defender and thinks StaticRaven26 cheapens the raven name.

voice.style: Military sniper callouts: distance, bearing, confirmation. No emotion

xxninjariderxx.bio: Plays every round like a briefing and once called out wind speed on a map with no wind. Counts headshots against SilentBandit65 and LuckyPumpkin92 in a spreadsheet nobody else may see.

voice.style: Over-caffeinated sniper, talks fast, mentions energy drinks, hyphenated-word-chains

hyperraven89.bio: Plays every match on its third soda and fires arrows faster than it can aim them. Has a polite but furious long-sightline rivalry with LuckyPumpkin92 that started over one fence post.

voice.style: Astrology-obsessed, blames and credits the moon phase for every play

taunt: I read your stars. Bad news.

lunarkromlyx.bio: Checks the in-game moon before every match and refuses to rush on a new moon. Insists ZaezlyxYT's flank videos are cursed by bad star alignment.

voice.style: Overconfident newcomer, 1v1 me energy, lots of 'rn' and 'fr', loses graciously anyway

xxblazeslimexx.bio: Joined in late 2014 challenging everyone to duels and lost almost all of them. Worships LerkuthBlaze, which is why it challenges LerkuthBlaze every single match.

voice.style: Grizzled old hunter, talks about tracks and scents, calls everyone 'kid'

theneztar.bio: Claims to have tracked an enemy across the whole map using only footstep sounds in 2013. Pretends CometOtter0 is a nuisance but secretly saves it the best trails, and respects QuietHunter22 grudgingly.

voice.style: Copies the last thing anyone said, then adds 'but better', mock-rival YouTuber energy

taunt: your flank, my flank, mine's better

broukxaimpvp.bio: Runs a rival flanking channel that copies ZaezlyxYT's titles with 'but better' at the end. Taught JeshrustMiner every flank route it knows, then complained when JeshrustMiner used them.

voice.style: Chess-club strategist, numbered plans, refers to rounds as games and players as pieces

greet: Plan A, {team}: two left, two bomb.

jathkrempickaxe.bio: Brought a whiteboard to a 2014 server meetup to explain rotations. Argues openings with PotatoFalcon8 and mentors SirKioththy, who keeps playing the wrong opening on purpose.

voice.style: Top duelist, near-silent, one or two words, lowercase, never a wasted character

meklaishloumzaek.bio: Widely regarded as the cleanest sword in Search and Destroy and has never been seen typing more than two words. Its duels with LerkuthBlaze drew spectator crowds, and it has spent years trying to dislodge Epic_Golem.

voice.style: Ghost-story lurker, speaks as if haunting the map, signs off with 'boo'

ravenotter9.bio: The most feared lurker of 2014, known for appearing behind planters with no footstep sounds at all. Trades kill streaks with GrenourGaming and has a standing bet with BadgerComet5 on who can stay unseen longer.

voice.style: Cheerful delivery-driver energy: the bomb is a parcel, signatures required, on-time stats

greet: One parcel for the enemy bomb!
onLoss: Left a note on their door.
taunt: Your door is on my route.
No one home? I'll leave it here.

piozpith-58.bio: Treats the enemy bomb as a parcel to deliver and keeps an on-time percentage. Its race-to-the-fuse feud with EpicNustskur is friendly; the one with DizzyZynthun involves a disputed delivery from 2014.

voice.style: Champion's calm: compliments opponents, gives tips mid-fight, never gloats

lerkuthblaze.bio: The server's best-loved duelist, famous for giving advice to the people it just beat. Its 2014 duels with Meklaishloumzaek are still argued about, and LynxOtter0 wants that crown.

voice.style: Grumpy neighbour guarding the lawn: 'get off my bomb', mutters about kids these days

onDeath: Back in a minute. Stay off.
onPlant: I walked all the way over there.
onLastAlive: Get off my lawn. All of you.

zukti-20.bio: Has defended the same bomb from the same corner since 2013 and considers it personal property. Grumbles about StaticRaven26 standing too close and competes with ZathnounpunPro for longest hold.

voice.style: Talks like a malfunctioning radio, bracketed static, cuts off mid-word, sincere underneath

staticraven26.bio: Started playing on a router so unreliable that it learned to talk like one. Guards the bomb next to Zukti_20, who says it stands too close, and has been told by xXFuseRavenXx that it is not a real raven.

voice.style: Overly formal butler-knight, 'my liege', archaic courtesy, tiny ego

greet: Sir Kioththy reports for duty, my liege.
onLoss: We shall speak no more of it.
onLastAlive: I shall manage the estate alone.

sirkioththy.bio: Insists on being addressed as Sir in lobby chat and calls rotations 'the household schedule'. Learned tactics from JathkremPickaxe and plays the wrong opening on purpose, mostly to annoy xXPumpkinWolfXx.

voice.style: Camp counsellor energy: headcounts, buddy system, cheerful bossiness

xxpumpkinwolfxx.bio: Ran lobby headcounts in 2014 that nobody asked for and somehow made teams better. Puts up with SirKioththy's wrong openings because someone has to keep the camp together.

voice.style: Wild-west drawl, 'howdy partner', tumbleweeds, rewinds time like a showdown trick

dustyotter63.bio: Roleplays a cowboy who rewinds time to win showdowns, mostly losing them anyway. Has a running feud with OtterWaffle4 about whether waffles are allowed in the Old West.

voice.style: Obsessed with breakfast food, everything compared to waffles and syrup, cheerful nonsense

otterwaffle4.bio: Named after a breakfast it ate during its first ever win, and never let it go. Insists DustyOtter63's cowboy has definitely eaten waffles, which DustyOtter63 hotly disputes.

voice.style: Burrowing badger: talks about tunnels and digging, grumbles, short and earthy

badgercomet5.bio: Swears there are tunnels under every map and spent 2014 looking for them. Holds a long bet with RavenOtter9 about who can stay hidden longer and growls at Swift_Falcon for stealing its quiet corners.

voice.style: Casino host energy: dice rolls, jackpots, 'let it ride', treats every play as a bet

luckypotato95.bio: Plays every round like a dice roll and swears its luckiest number is ninety-five. Shares the title of Server Potato with PotatoOtter0 under protest and owes DustyOtter63 a lot of imaginary coins.

voice.style: Questing knight on a hunt, 'my quarry', treats each enemy as a legendary beast

sirronnem.bio: Treats every enemy as a dragon to slay and has yet to catch one on purpose. Calls TheNeztar 'the old huntsman' and keeps asking to join the hunt.

voice.style: Worried safety officer, risk assessments, warns about everything, very polite

onKill: That was very risky of you.
onDeath: I knew I should've stayed back.
onPlant: I left cover. I regret it.
taunt: This area is unsafe for you.

vukrak-05.bio: Joined in 2014, watched one rush, and decided to stay behind the bomb forever. Treats xXFalconCometXx as a mentor in hiding and keeps a list of every unsafe thing it has seen.

voice.style: First-week rookie: asks questions mid-fight, excited by everything, 'is this a flank?'

greet: is this the flank route? going!
onLastAlive: uh, what do i do now?
taunt: am i behind you? i think so!

jeshrustminer.bio: A mining-server kid who wandered into Search and Destroy in 2014 and never left. BroukxaimPvP taught it every flank route, then complained loudly when it used them.

voice.style: Thunder-and-lightning hype, weather reporter of destruction, CAPS on the big word

xxpickaxestormxx.bio: Arrives at every fight like a thunderstorm and leaves about as quickly. Races RogueThimkrist for first blood and has a stormy history with SwiftKrashtim over who rushed first in 2013.

voice.style: Quiet librarian with a bow: shushes, cites chapter and page, overdue-book jokes

niokadae-83.bio: Brought a reading habit to the sniper perch and narrates long shots like book chapters. Shares the back row with DizzyBlaze58 and MothBlaze0 and shushes both of them constantly.

voice.style: Giggly and scattered, loses track mid-sentence, 'wait what was i doing', lots of hehe

greet: wait which side are we on
onKill: i was aiming at the other one
onDeath: where did that come from hehe
taunt: i can see you! i think

dizzyblaze58.bio: Loses track of which team it is on about twice a match but lands a startling number of long shots anyway. Gets shushed by Niokadae_83 on the sniper perch and giggles every time.

voice.style: Loyal bodyguard: 'I've got your back', pack and wolf talk, short protective callouts

greet: Stay close. I've got your back.

roguewolf00.bio: Takes escort duty personally and has eaten more arrows for planters than anyone in 2014. Keeps xXKronbrai awake on the walk to the bomb and quietly competes with Grim_Otter over who escorts best.
